title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Synthetic role: deliver reliable model-serving systems with an application team. Own Python services, containerized deployment and model monitoring. Expected experience: at least 4 years of relevant ML engineering; research-only experience needs clarification.
screening_criteria: Develop maintainable Python machine learning services.
Deploy containerized models and describe production serving ownership.
Monitor model quality and operational behavior after deployment.
At least 4 years of relevant ML engineering experience.

questions.text: Describe a model-serving incident and what you personally changed.
How would you package and test a Python model service before release?
Which monitoring signals did you own, and what ML engineering experience supports that work?

requirements.description: Develop maintainable Python machine learning services.
Deploy containerized models and describe production serving ownership.
Monitor model quality and operational behavior after deployment.
At least 4 years of relevant ML engineering experience.
Computing or engineering degree, certification or equivalent applied study.
